missing: A single list covering every brand's Thunderbolt 4 NAS (QNAP's TBS-h574TX, TVS-h674T/h874T and TS-h966TX, plus UGREEN's DXP480T Plus, 6800 Pro and 8800 Plus), with current prices. why: No major reviewer has compared NAS models with Thunderbolt 4 for connecting directly to a Mac. Macworld's tested review covers only the TBS-h574TX, and TechRadar's general NAS guide mentions the TVS-h674T only in passing. The other results are single-brand pages from QNAP and UGREEN, and video-editing listicles that make one Thunderbolt pick. Two niche sites cover only part of the field: terabytewise lists the UGREEN models and juicemount lists the QNAP ones. A page covering both brands, with current prices and a direct pick, would stand out.
